newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips slump on last trading day of year.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips slump on last trading day of year.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks slumped more than 100 points Tuesday in the last trading session of the year as stronger-than-expected economic data raised fears of inflation and sparked a sell-off in the bond market.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 101.10 points to close at 6,448.27 -- but was still up more than 1,300 points for all of 1996. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a narrow margin on moderate volume of about 399 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
